name: Select
blurb: A dropdown for choosing one option from a short list.
mechanism: `<details>` for the disclosure, one delegated click handler, and a hidden input so the value posts like a native select.
caveats: You give up type-to-select, arrow keys and the iOS wheel picker. Tab walks the options and Enter picks one.
It announces as a disclosure with options inside, not as a select. A native `<select>` with appearance-none is the accessible choice when the open list does not have to match your design.
